sections.label: Fixes
sections.description: Bugs: a bomber with no muzzles stopped other units' targeting; aircraft inside a shield's bubble hit everything under it; the Chosen T2 point defence and the EDA T3 anti-air fighter shot the ground; bombs expired before they could land; the TALEN gunship was labelled tier 1.

sections.label: Economy
sections.description: Commanders make 3 alloys and 30 energy a second (were 5 and 50) and start you with full storage, 500 alloys and 5000 energy (was half, 250 and 2500). T2 and T3 extractors make 5 and 15 (were 4 and 10); generators make 20/600/2500 energy (were 10/200/1000), and T3 ones cost 2800 alloys (were 5000). Factories cost 200 alloys (were 150), upgrading one to T2 costs 1500 (was 500) and to T3 4000 (was 2000), and T3 tanks and the Guardian T3 raider cost 30% less. T2 radar uses 250 energy a second (was 150) and T3 radar costs 2800 alloys (was 700) and 1400 energy a second (was 350); EDA and Chosen T3 radar see 750 and 850 (were 450 and 550). Wrecks reclaim 3x as fast and last 6 minutes (were 3). Land units cost 6 energy per alloy (were 10), Chosen aircraft as much energy as the others, and engineers have less than half their health.

sections.label: Commanders
sections.description: The EDA and Guardian commanders' missiles fly at once and steer at where the target is going, in smaller, faster volleys: they hit moving units as often as the Chosen commander does.

sections.label: Artillery
sections.description: Artillery leads moving targets (it couldn't hit anything moving in a straight line); the three factions' T1 artillery are brought level.

sections.label: Air
sections.description: Bombers lead their targets and their bombs splash; anti-air leads its shots and the T3 anti-air towers reach their range; the Guardian fighters catch up with the others.

sections.label: Defences
sections.description: Point defences see as far as they shoot, and T1 point defences are tougher: they beat their cost in T1 tanks, while T1 artillery still outranges them.

sections.label: Unit tuning
sections.description: The Chosen Jager toned down and the other T2 raiders brought up, so T2 beats its cost in T1 without crushing it; the three T1 tanks brought level; T3 tanks move as fast as T1 tanks with quicker guns, and the Guardian T3 raider is faster still but fragile; T4 bots move at 2.5-3.5 (were 2), brawlers fastest, and are game enders: 10000-25000 alloys with health and damage to match, slightly better per alloy than T3 tanks; the EDA railgun sniper reaches 80.

changes.name: Redoubt
changes.label: yaw bone
why: The Chosen T2 point defence (Redoubt) shot the ground: its model's barrel bone rests about 55 degrees nose-down, and it may only pitch up 45, so it could never raise the barrel to level. It never came on target (0% in tests at 20-47 range, other T2 point defences 48-94%). It may pitch up 100 now, rests level, and turns the model's real yaw bone (it named Turret01, which the model doesn't have).

changes.name: Behemoth
changes.label: cost
why: T4s are game enders for long 512 games that become spammable as the game goes on: they cost 10000-25000 alloys (2-3x what they did, energy 6 per alloy), and their health and damage are raised so that per alloy they beat the average T3 tank (15.8 health and 0.49 damage a second per alloy, after this patch's T3 discount) by 10%, or match it for the 60-100 range ones (Djinn, Chosen big bot). The Quasar is matched against T3 artillery and keeps its health. Damage counts every muzzle and salvo (my arithmetic on the templates); death explosions are unchanged. EDA Behemoth: 10000 alloys (was 3696), 175000 health (was 72000) and 3.3x weapon damage.

notes: Targeting (append to host/units/weaponsClasses/weaponsBaseClass.lua, with "fixes" on): a weapon whose muzzles aren't in its model (the Guardian T1 and T3 bombers, the Chosen T3 bomber, the EDA T2 raider, the TALEN) picks no target. Before, its target search threw an error that stopped every weapon queued after it from picking a new target, every tick, for as long as it had an enemy in range. Not a template change.

Shields (balancepatch/shields.lua, with the "fixes" section on): an aircraft's projectile that starts inside an enemy shield's bubble and lands inside it hits the shield instead, and so does an aircraft's beam fired from inside one. Before, gunships and bombers flew inside T3 bubbles and hit everything under them. Units on the ground inside a bubble shoot as before. Not a template change.
AI: the stock AI's energy-to-alloy income targets (LessThan/MoreThanEnergyToResourceRatioIncome in AI/AIFunctions.lua) are scaled by 0.7 when the "economy" section is on. Not a template change.
